product_name: 便携式爆炸物探测仪 FC1800B
summary: 便携式爆炸物毒品探测仪是我公司开发的新一代便携式光电离爆炸物和毒品检测仪，该产品采用先进的光电离高分辨离子迁移谱技术，不含放射源，对人体无任何辐射危害。具有检测速度快、检测灵敏度高、功耗低、体积小、质量轻、便于携带、易于维护、使用环境和要求适应性强等特点，能同时准确检测出黑火药以及国际民航组织规定的全部爆炸物和毒品。该设备具备正、负双模式，可实现纳克级精准识别并报出危险品品名，是现场快速查验的理想工具。
summary_en: The FC1800B Portable Explosives and Narcotics Detector is our next-generation security instrument. Utilizing advanced photoionization high-resolution Ion Mobility Spectrometry (IMS) technology, it is entirely non-radioactive and poses zero radiation hazard to the human body. It features rapid detection, high sensitivity, low power consumption, and a compact, lightweight design for exceptional portability. Designed for ease of maintenance and high adaptability to various environments, it can accurately detect black powder, all explosives specified by ICAO, and a wide variety of narcotics simultaneously. With its dual-mode (positive/negative) capability, it provides nanogram-level identification and reports the specific names of detected substances, making it an ideal tool for rapid on-site inspections.
key_application: 应用领域：便携爆炸物探测仪FC1800B；采用非放射性光电离技术，可同时精准检测爆炸物与毒品，结果展现迅速、精准。
key_application_en: Non-radioactive trace detection of explosives and narcotics; 2-second ultra-fast analysis; lightweight (<4kg) for superior individual mobility; comprehensive database for ICAO explosives and common narcotics; 800,000+ data storage capacity.
key_parameter_1: 探测灵敏度: 1 纳克 TNT 标准炸药

parameters.采用技术: 光电离高分辨离子迁移谱 (IMS) - 无放射性源
parameters.检测物类别: 正、负双模式，同时检测爆炸物 (TNT/RDX/黑火药等) 与毒品 (海洛因/冰毒等)
parameters.取样方式: 痕量颗粒吸附采样、试纸擦拭取样、空气采样
parameters.操作界面: 2.8寸 TFT 彩色触摸屏，中文/英文双语系统
parameters.存储容量: 不少于 80 万条数据，支持检索及导出
parameters.电池续航: 连续工作 > 2 小时，待机 > 12 小时
parameters.自校准/自诊断: 具有自动环境适应校准与故障实时报警诊断功能

parameters_en.Substances: Dual-mode detection for explosives (TNT, RDX, etc.) and narcotics (Heroin, Meth, etc.)
parameters_en.Sampling: Trace particle swiping or direct air sampling
parameters_en.Storage Capacity: ≥ 800,000 records with USB retrieval and export
parameters_en.Self-Calibration: Automatic environmental adaptation and real-time failure diagnostics

detail_html:
功能特点

  • 核级安全无辐射：全球领先的高分辨离子迁移谱技术，不含化学放射源，保障操作员完全健康。
  • 一机双模探测：单次检测即可覆盖毒品与爆炸物全品类，支持主成分与混合物成分分析。
  • 极速现场响应：2秒出结果，内置自清洗功能可快速处理过负荷检测，无需长时间停机。
  • 纳克级精准识别：可准确识别黑火药及各类民用/土制炸药，并实时播报具体物质品名。
  • 海量情报管理：支持80万条记录存储并可导出USB，开放式数据库支持云端样本库随时升级。
  • 工业级机动性：整机重量低于4kg，配备高强度安全箱，适应-20℃至60℃严苛气候工作。
  • Figure 1 Portable Explosives Detector
detail_html_en:
Features

  • Non-Radioactive Safety: utilizes vacuum UV photoionization, eliminating the need for radioactive source permits and guaranteeing operator safety.
  • Dual-Path Engineering: simultaneous positive and negative ion analysis enables comprehensive screening for both narcotics and explosives in one step.
  • Instantaneous Feedback: yields actionable results in under 2 seconds; features a built-in self-cleaning mechanism for high-frequency testing.
  • Nanogram Sensitivity: identifies trace amounts of black powder and industrial explosives with zero false positives for common background items.
  • Data Intelligence: massive 800,000-log storage with USB export and an open-architecture database for rapid sample library expansions.
  • Rugged Portability: weighing less than 4kg, the system is designed for field use in temperatures ranging from -20°C to 60°C.
